item.title: Pine Pollen
item.description:
What it is: Pine pollen is the male reproductive spore from pine trees, traditionally used in traditional Chinese medicine for male vitality. It contains naturally-occurring androgens, amino acids, and micronutrients that support testosterone, energy, and male sexual function.

Benefits

Testosterone Support

  • May support healthy testosterone levels
  • Contains naturally-occurring androgens
  • Particularly effective when baseline is low
  • Supports male vitality and performance
  • Athletic performance improvement

Male Sexual Function

  • Supports erectile function and libido
  • Enhances sexual desire and arousal
  • Improves sexual satisfaction
  • Energy and confidence support

Overall Energy & Vitality

  • Rich in amino acids and nutrients
  • Supports overall vitality and energy
  • May improve mood and motivation
  • Athletic performance support
  • Physical resilience

Nutrient Density

  • Whole food containing multiple nutrients
  • Amino acids and vitamins
  • Mineral content support
  • Natural food matrix benefits

Dosage

Vitality support: 1,000-1,500 mg daily Enhanced: 1,500-2,000 mg daily Full: 2,000-3,000 mg daily Timing: With meals Duration: 2-4 weeks to assess effects; better long-term for full benefits

item.title: Tongkat Ali
item.description:
What it is: Tongkat Ali is a traditional Malaysian herbal containing quassinoids and other compounds that support testosterone production, sexual function, and athletic performance. Modern research validates its testosterone-boosting properties and muscle-building support.

Benefits

Testosterone Support

  • May significantly support healthy testosterone levels
  • Particularly effective when baseline is low
  • Supports male vitality and confidence
  • Athletic performance improvement
  • Results documented in clinical research

Sexual Function & Libido

  • Improves sexual desire and arousal
  • Supports erectile function
  • Enhances sexual satisfaction
  • Improves sexual performance
  • Female sexual function support too

Athletic Performance

  • May improve muscle gains from training
  • Supports strength and power output
  • Enhances workout performance
  • Faster recovery post-exercise
  • Particularly valuable for athletes

Overall Vitality & Energy

  • May improve energy and mood
  • Supports confidence and motivation
  • Complements healthy lifestyle
  • Athletic resilience support

Dosage

Testosterone support: 300-400 mg daily Enhanced: 400-600 mg daily Full spectrum: 600-1,000 mg daily Timing: With meals Duration: 2-4 weeks for initial effects; 8+ weeks for full testosterone optimization

item.title: Tribulus Terrestris
item.description:
What it is: Tribulus terrestris is a traditional herbal containing saponin compounds that support testosterone production, sexual function, and athletic performance. Used in Ayurvedic and traditional medicine for millennia, modern research validates its testosterone and libido-supporting properties.

Benefits

Testosterone Support

  • May support healthy testosterone levels
  • Particularly effective when baseline is low
  • Supports sexual function through hormonal mechanism
  • Athletic performance improvement

Sexual Function & Libido

  • Improves sexual desire and arousal
  • Supports erectile function
  • Enhances sexual satisfaction
  • Works for both men and women

Athletic Performance

  • May improve muscle gains from training
  • Supports strength and power output
  • Enhances workout performance
  • Recovery support

Overall Vitality

  • May improve energy and mood
  • Supports general well-being
  • Complements healthy lifestyle

Dosage

Sexual support: 500-750 mg daily Enhanced: 750-1,000 mg daily Full: 1,000-1,500 mg daily Timing: With meals Duration: 4-8 weeks to assess effects
